name: Judy Satori
reason: Health rule: her own site (ascensionlibrary.org, read 10 Nov 2026) sells light-language recordings mainly on bodily claims, e.g. 'Daily Nervous System Support', 'Mitochondrial Support' working at the cellular level, transmissions said to have a regenerative effect on the body and to activate changes in cells and DNA; the catalogue is condition-led, so too little would pass the strict health rule.
